evidence.title: Color Palette Generator – Color Wheel Tool | Adobe Express

name: Color Palette Generator – Color Wheel Tool
summary: Adobe's free online color wheel for building palettes from a base color, harmony rules or an uploaded image.
description: An online color palette generator: pick a base color or upload an image to extract colors, choose a harmony (monochromatic, complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary), preview the palette with a color-blindness simulation and contrast ratio, and save it to a library. Links to a contrast checker, an image gradient extractor and a palette explorer.
contains: interactive color wheel with harmony rules
palette extraction from an uploaded image
on-page preview with contrast ratio and color-blindness simulation
contrast checker, gradient extractor and palette explorer
save palettes to an Adobe library
